name: Hot Sauce
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in typical serving sizes. Choose brands without garlic or onion powder for strictest SIBO protocols.
preparationTips: Read labels carefully - some brands contain garlic or onion powder
Start with small amounts to test individual tolerance
Vinegar-based hot sauces are typically safest for FODMAPs
Store opened bottles in refrigerator to maintain quality
alternatives: Homemade hot sauce with chili peppers and vinegar
